reviews.text:
We love Bark n Bone! They’ve been taking care of our girl Olga (hound/staffy mix) for almost 4 years. The whole team is super reliable, responsive and so helpful.
Especially since we’ve had to adjust her routine as a senior pup. Highly recommend to anyone in need of pet care 🐾
Siobhan and Faye are amazing with my dog and foster dog. My foster dog is nervous, they read his cues and give a thoughtful report. Olivia made the process so easy.

Bark&Bone has been taking incredible care of our dog, Andre, for the past two years. He’s pretty timid and sensitive, but their walkers all were able to build trust with him and keep him safe. They regularly send photos and updates which puts us at ease. They’ve been consistently reliable and professional from day one. We highly recommend them.
The best in the business. Highly recommend!
Really great experience with Bark&Bone! They have been super accomadating with our new puppy and always send cute little updates. We appreciate it so much!

Our 12-year-old dog Alice spent 2 weeks in Astoria with our daughter, a regular client of Bark and Bone. Alice is usually quite tentative around new humans, but she was comfortable from the first with the B and B dog walkers. They were capable, efficient, and low-key, especially Siobhan, who spent the most time with Alice. It was stress-free, and a great experience.

We love Bark & Bone!
I've been using B&B multiple times a week for the last 3 years.
They always communicate, they're easy to schedule with, and all of the walkers we've worked with have been respectful and helpful.
One of the walkers, Siobhan, has been exceptional with accommodating our needs and going above and beyond. It is such a relief to have a team we can trust. (And our dog loves!)
Bruce (my dog) always looks so happy in the photos they send.
We are so grateful to have Olivia and her team helping us.
10/10 would recommend.

The care and consideration I received by dog walker Caleb is phenomenal! I cannot recommend Olivia and her company enough+ Caleb more!

Caleb has gone above and beyond each visit for my new corgi puppy, even going as far to clean up his vomit when his tummy was hurting. I have no worries about my puppy once when I knew Caleb was coming to visit. He follows every single request to a T!

Caleb, if you see this, thank you SO MUCH! Winston will definitely miss you! 🐾

5/5! What a wonderful dog walking business. Barknbone walked my beloved puppy Jetty every weekday for an entire school year. The walkers are extremely reliable and provide updates every day. We felt great knowing that we could work our in person jobs and Jetty could still get out and go for a nice walk. They are extremely flexible with adding walks. They even took care of our pup when he was recovering from surgery! We are so sad to be moving and leaving our amazing walkers!

Very reliable & friendly dog walkers - reasonably priced too for nyc! Easy to schedule & manage online. We’ve been using them a few days a week every week for about 3 months now & have had a really positive experience

We love Bark & Bone!! The walkers are kind and responsible and give detailed reports and photos after each walk. They truly make it so stress free because you know your pup is happy and well taken care of.

That said, what really stands out to me about b&b is the total customization- there are no minimum weekly requirements and you can create a weekly schedule based on your needs. They have a VERY gracious cancellation/changes window so you can adjust a walk the night before or early morning of if needed. They have been a game changer with hybrid work.  I can’t recommend them enough!

My sweet pup and I LOVE Bark and Bone. The walkers are kind and professional and I feel confident that she’s in good hands. They utilize an app for scheduling, payment, and communication which streamlines the whole experience. I have used many different services for caring for my dog and this is by far the best.

I really don’t know what I would do without Caleb. Caleb treats my doghter like she’s her own. Since I travel so much for work, it’s great knowing that I can trust Caleb to take care of my girl. It really makes me not want to move anywhere other than the areas they service.
We love Bark & Bone! All the staff and walkers are so incredibly professional and they treat our dogs so well! I would recommend them to anyone seeking a dog walking service for their pets!

We’ve been using Bark and Bone for almost 8 years, we love how communicative and caring the cat sitters are. They go the extra mile and send great photos and updates. We’re very comfortable having such responsible people watching over our cat!

I was very nervous when I had to go back into the office and we needed to find a Dogwalker for our dog. I wanted to make sure we found a reliable service with kind and gentle people taking care of our dog Junior. Everyone at Bark and Bone has been amazing for the past year, taking such great care of our boy. They alleviated my fears right away. They provide lovely reports and pictures and scheduling appointments is very easy. They have also been very consistent and reliable. Thank you all so much!

We love Bark & Bone! We’ve been using Bark & Bone for 5+ years for our dog Bruce. From his early days as a new puppy till now, Bark & Bone have been phenomenal. They make booking walks a total breeze. Bruce loves his walks and all of the local pups he gets to hang with each day! We highly recommend Bark & Bone to any other dog owners!

Bark & Bone walked my doggo for 2+ years and provided excellent service. I would still use their services but I moved out of the neighborhood. Leaving review to let those know who are knew to Astoria and looking for a good dog walking company, Bark & Bone is a great pick! The walkers always provided detailed reports and many photos for each walk. Setting up scheduling is easy to do in the Time to Pet app or by emailing with Olivia to set up a recurring schedule. Thank you Bark & Bone!

I can't say enough good things about Bark n' Bone. I have a senior dog and her safety and well being is always top of mind, especially as she ages. The staff here were always very attentive to her needs and made sure she had great walks while I was away. I highly recommend their services for those looking to have their pet taken care of by some of the friendliest people in the business!
